components.name: Primary Gold Button
components.description: The decisive action for logging or confirming progress.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B8923E, var(--performance-gold, #D4A853)); color: #070806; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--performance-gold, #D4A853), #E8C078); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(212, 168, 83, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8C078; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action that preserves the evidence hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #333333); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--content-secondary, #D6D3D1); font: 500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #57534E); background: var(--surface-hover, #222222); color: var(--content-primary, #FAFAF9); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--surface-active, #2A2A2A); }

components.name: Daily Macro Strip
components.description: A four-cell evidence rail for honest daily nutrition values.
components.html:
Protein14g
Carbs40g
Fat1g
SugarNot available
components.css: .ds-macro-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--performance-rail, rgba(245,247,242,.14)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-macro-cell { min-width: 0; padding: 11px 9px 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--performance-rail, rgba(245,247,242,.14)); } .ds-macro-cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-macro-cell span { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-macro-cell strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; overflow: hidden; font: 500 13px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-macro-cell .ds-wrap { font-size: 11px; white-space: normal; } .ds-coral { color: var(--performance-coral, #FF6573); } .ds-cyan { color: var(--performance-cyan, #42D7FF); } .ds-violet { color: var(--performance-violet, #9567F2); } .ds-orange { color: var(--performance-orange, #FF7A1A); }

components.name: Active Performance Row
components.description: A split-sheet row with a cyan state rail and tabular metric.
components.html:
Bench press3 sets · Barbell
80 KG × 5
components.css: .ds-result-row { display: flex; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--performance-rail, rgba(245,247,242,.14)); background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--performance-cyan, #42D7FF); color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-result-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-result-copy strong, .ds-result-copy span { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-result-copy strong { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-result-copy span { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-size: 12px; } .ds-result-metric { color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); font: 500 12px/1.2 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Strength Workout Mode
components.description: The visual training-intent entry built from anatomical imagery and lime illumination.
components.css: .ds-workout-mode { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 168px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-lime, #B7F10A) 28%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-lime, #B7F10A) 25%, transparent), #050606 62%); color: var(--performance-lime, #B7F10A); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; isolation: isolate; } .ds-anatomy { position: absolute; inset: 2px 25% 0; width: 50%; height: 96%; fill: #2B3330; stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-cyan, #42D7FF) 75%, white); stroke-width: 2; transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-workout-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 24%, rgba(2,3,3,.9) 100%); } .ds-workout-copy { position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 14px; left: 14px; } .ds-workout-copy strong, .ds-workout-copy small { display: block; } .ds-workout-copy strong { font: 700 17px/1.15 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-workout-copy small { margin-top: 4px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.76); font: 400 11px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-workout-mode:hover .ds-anatomy { transform: scale(1.035); } .ds-workout-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-workout-mode:active { filter: brightness(.94); }

components.name: Session Exercise Identity
components.description: The compact image-first identity row above a set logging grid.
components.css: .ds-exercise-identity { display: flex; min-height: 80px; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--performance-rail, rgba(245,247,242,.14)); background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-exercise-visual { display: block; width: 68px; height: 60px; flex: none; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 11px; background: #070806; } .ds-exercise-visual svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: #29312E; stroke: var(--performance-cyan, #42D7FF); stroke-width: 1.5; } .ds-exercise-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-exercise-copy strong, .ds-exercise-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-exercise-copy strong { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-exercise-copy small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-size: 11px; } .ds-exercise-copy .ds-exercise-last { color: var(--performance-cyan, #42D7FF); } .ds-chevron { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-exercise-identity:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #222222); } .ds-exercise-identity:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-exercise-identity:active { background: var(--surface-active, #2A2A2A); }

components.name: Coach Conversation Header
components.description: Persistent coach identity and private-line status above a conversation.
components.html: CCoach CodexPrivate coach line
components.css: .ds-coach-header { display: flex; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--performance-rail, rgba(245,247,242,.14)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-canvas, #070806) 96%, transparent); color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(18px); } .ds-coach-header > button { display: grid; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); cursor: pointer; } .ds-coach-header > button svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-coach-header > button:hover { color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); } .ds-coach-header > button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-coach-avatar { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-gold, #D4A853) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 13px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--performance-gold, #D4A853) 14%, var(--performance-surface, #151717)); color: var(--performance-gold, #D4A853); font: 750 14px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-coach-copy strong, .ds-coach-copy small { display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-coach-copy strong { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-coach-copy small { gap: 4px; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-size: 11px; } .ds-coach-copy small svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; }

components.name: Chat Composer Field
components.description: A restrained message field that keeps the coach thread visually dominant.
components.css: .ds-chat-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); } .ds-chat-field input { min-height: 44px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #333333); border-radius: 12px; outline: none; background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); color: var(--performance-ink, #F5F7F2); font: 400 16px/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-chat-field input::placeholder { color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); } .ds-chat-field input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #57534E); } .ds-chat-field input:focus { border-color: var(--performance-gold, #D4A853); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212,168,83,.1); } .ds-chat-field button { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--performance-surface, #151717); color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chat-field button:hover { color: var(--performance-gold, #D4A853); } .ds-chat-field button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chat-field button svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Floating Bottom Navigation
components.description: The stable five-slot client navigation with a gold active rail.
components.html: HomeLogWorkoutProgressMe
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: flex; min-height: 56px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #333333); border-radius: 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-overlay, #1A1A1A) 95%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-medium, 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)); color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 56px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--performance-muted, #A9AEAA); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .05em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; opacity: .75; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #222222); color: var(--content-secondary, #D6D3D1); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #E8C078); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--surface-active, #2A2A2A); color: var(--performance-gold, #D4A853); } .ds-nav-active svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-active-rail { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 36px; height: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--performance-gold, #D4A853); }

narrative.overview:
Personal Best is a compact athlete evidence board inspired by race timing boards, split sheets, and premium coaching dossiers; it refuses generic glass-card SaaS. Its visual thesis is dense but calm: the interface reads as a sequence of measured facts, coach cues, and clear next actions, organized by disciplined rails instead of ornamental containers.

The material world is obsidian/graphite; Trophē gold for identity and primary actions; lime, cyan, coral, violet as performance channels; disciplined rails; tabular/mono evidence; anatomical workout imagery. In use, Nik opens a compact coach-led day, reads honest nutrition evidence, enters a visual progressive workout flow, and can reach a clearly identified private coach conversation.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence rows and split-sheet dividers with tabular metrics.
Anatomical workout imagery anchored in black fields.
Theme-aware contrast with identical hierarchy in light and dark.
A stable floating five-slot navigation rail.

rules.name: The Channel Integrity Rule
rules.body: Gold identifies Trophē and primary intent; lime, cyan, coral, violet, and orange encode performance meaning and are never sprayed across unrelated decoration.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Measurements, ratios, dates, and channel values use the mono voice with tabular numerals; conversational coaching copy remains in Inter.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Identity, greeting, plan, honest nutrition evidence, training intent, and coach access appear in that reading order; visual density must never hide the next useful fact.

rules.name: The Rail-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use tonal separation and a disciplined one-pixel rail before adding elevation; shadows indicate floating context, not generic card decoration.

dos: Do keep the finish premium, fast, legible in light/dark, user-friendly, non-generic, production credible.
Do state unavailable or incomplete evidence honestly instead of fabricating a complete metric.
Do use anatomical workout imagery to make training intent immediately scannable.
Do preserve 44px minimum touch targets, visible focus, safe areas, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep gold rare enough to preserve identity and action priority.
donts: Don't turn the client app into generic glass-card SaaS.
Don't use performance channels as interchangeable decoration or allow them to compete with Trophē gold.
Don't widen compact client flows into sprawling desktop dashboards.
Don't hide the coach's identity or blur the distinction between private conversation and generic messaging.
Don't replace evidence rails and tabular values with soft ornamental cards or vague summaries.
